scope_conflicts.issue: 2018 Art 5 eligible PSP includes banks/EMFs/EPs versus 2023 circular introduction PSP 'exclusively' provides payment services
scope_conflicts.classification: apparent terminology/scope tension; not an adjudicated contradiction
scope_conflicts.action: obtain issuer/counsel interpretation; distinguish institution type from authorized service/product; no categorical bank exemption or blanket inclusion

scope_conflicts.issue: 2023 Section I erroneous mobile transfers versus Section IV instant transfers/merchant payments 'par téléphone mobile ou non'
scope_conflicts.action: rule engine requires explicit service subtype, channel, transaction type and signed applicability decision; no generic mobile-only or all-rails rule

scope_conflicts.issue: 2018 Art 1 exclusions include payments made by central bank/treasuries/postal financial services, while Art 5 covers eligible PSP categories
scope_conflicts.action: do not infer that all flows routed via central-bank infrastructure are excluded or included; legal assessment required

scope_conflicts.issue: 2018 Art 6 payment institution distinct from Art 5 broad PSP, with separate Article 7/8 activity constraints
scope_conflicts.action: never apply payment-institution deposit/account prohibitions mechanically to licensed banks; profile per entity

participant_modes.requirement: bank-specific signed agreement, account authority, technical tests

participant_modes.requirement: documented intermediary and bank-specific settlement/technical responsibilities

participant_modes.beac_description: no own settlement account, not known to system
participant_modes.requirement: no fabricated direct settlement account; correspondent contractual and reconciliation evidence

candidate_domain_ownership.RegulatoryPolicy: legal instruments, provenance, bitemporal applicability, signed interpretations and approval workflow
candidate_domain_ownership.InstitutionEntitlement: bank authorization, product and participant-mode records, effective-dated contracts
candidate_domain_ownership.PaymentInstruction: original instruction, customer authorization, payment idempotency
candidate_domain_ownership.RestitutionCase: claim, notice, hold, consent/objection, legal escalation and evidence clocks
candidate_domain_ownership.RailAdapter: authenticated scheme messages, version and unknown external outcomes
candidate_domain_ownership.AccountingCore: only approved balanced immutable postings for separately authorized return
candidate_domain_ownership.IndependentReconciliation: scheme settlement evidence, journals, suspense and exceptions

invariants: No activation based only on public index or regulator website
No automatic bank exclusion/inclusion without license/product scope
No unconditional 5-minute rule across all rails
No instant module or SYGMA V10 production claim without issuer evidence
No direct balance mutation, posted journal edit or settlement inferred from clearing ACK
Unknown external outcome persists across retries/DR and prohibits duplicate returns
No maker approving own exceptional hold/restitution, no cross-tenant evidence use
